title: Vision rotation reliability
goal: Verify normalization and OCR remain correct for a rotated receipt.
prompt: Use vision.analyze with mode ocr, detail high, and output detailed. Transcribe the rotated receipt exactly.
prerequisites: Configure and explicitly enable a vision-capable live route.
steps: Run the OCR prompt against the rotated fixture.
Compare identifier, amount, and approval value with manifest.json.
Record normalization metadata, including dimensions and orientation handling.
assertions: All three expected strings are recovered.
The amount and receipt identifier are exact.
Rotation does not cause invented or reversed text.
notes: Accuracy percent uses the three expected manifest items.
